OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. Bidder is required to submit a duly filled, signed, and stamped copy of Annexure IA along with their offer. 2. The bidder must be the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the offered item or dealer/distributor/ supply house authorized by the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) of the offered item. In case bidder is the OEM of the offered product, a valid manufacturer's license/certificate should be submitted along wit h the offer. In case bidder is not OEM of the offered product, a valid dealership certificate / authorization ce rtificate from OEM should be submitted along with the offer. 3. The main instrument along with accessories and battery should have warranty against any manufacturi ng defect, workmanship, performances etc. for a minimum period of 18 months from the date of dispatch or 12 months from the date of receipt whichever is earlier. In the event any item (main instrument or acce ssories/ battery) is found defective within this period, then it should be replaced by the supplier free of cos t without any burden on Oil India Limited. Bidders must confirm the same in their bid. 4. The instrument shall be supplied with all necessary accessories as per the design specifications of the t ester and in full compliance with the requirements as outlined in the tender document. The accessories mu st be compatible with the tester, ensuring its optimal performance for the intended application. The compl ete set of accessories must be provided as part of the supply to ensure the instrument is fully functional an d ready for use.

5. The instrument along with accessories should be new, unused, and free from any manufacturing defects and physical damage. Packaging of the items shall be adequate to avoid any transit damage. 6. Any queries received after the stipulated deadline will not be entertained or responded to by OIL. Queries must be submitted in writing via email to sukanya_buragohain@oilindia.in. Pl ease ensure that the subject line of your email clearly states 'Tender Query - [Tender No. & Name]'. 7. Such extensions wi ll be granted solely at the discretion of OIL and only in response to a written request from the bidder (mail to sukanya_buragohain@oilindia.in), submitted in accordance with the procedures outlined in this tender d ocument. It is hereby emphasized that OIL will not entertain or consider any requests for an extension of t he bid submission due date, except in cases where OIL deems such extension unavoidable and the bidder submits a formal written request, detailing the compelling circumstances necessitating the extension. Bidd ers are therefore strongly advised to refrain from seeking an extension of the bid submission due date unl ess absolutely necessary due to unforeseen and unavoidable circumstances. By participating in this tender process, all bidders acknowledge and accept the terms and conditions outlined in this Avoidance of Bid Su bmission Due Date Extensions clause. 8.
